semantic_fidelity.reason: All six concepts and seven endpoints are represented across v1/v2, including separate core->Redis and Web->Redis links, and speed labels are intact. However v2 session [33,20,7,1] directly abuts the Web->DB stem instead of unambiguously identifying Web->Redis. The blind owner uncertainty remains a meaning-level defect after reveal; JSON ownership does not repair it. No unrelated relation was knowingly added.

arrow_traceability.reason: Static stems and unique downward arrowheads are geometrically traceable on all seven independent routes, with no fake bus or junction. But every frame-0 dot starts one cell downstream of the first drawn exterior origin. The rubric explicitly makes direction unproven in this case; static arrowheads do not waive that rule. The session owner ambiguity further prevents a reliable labelled-edge reading.

layout_fit.reason: Both captured grids are 77x47 at natural 100% and no graph content is clipped. Splitting is allowed and the endpoint coverage map is complete. There are 0 crossings in v1 and 1 at (40,21) in v2. That crossing is avoidable by source-port ordering without changing any node tier, source group or relation: Web->Redis can leave the left port and Web->DB the right port. The claim that the crossing is structural is not supported. Separately the actual live pane width/rectangle is missing, so the pane-size portion remains an evidence gap, not a pass.

conceptual_grouping_color.reason: Gruvbox hue families follow concepts, not depth: WAN/Firewall are adjacent warm edge nodes; Core is switching; Web is app; Redis and DB share a nearby related teal data family in v2. The application chain respects Web->Redis->DB order. Different normal colors for repeated Web/Redis between views are not a separate gate. No alphabetical/depth-based group claim is needed.

border_integrity.reason: All sides and four rounded corners are complete and have a single per-node RGB color in normal ANSI captures. Selected ANSI proves all 5 v1 and all 3 v2 node occurrences have continuous bold (216,166,87) selected borders: 8/8 occurrence coverage. All-selected appearance does not prove separate interactive click behavior; that is not claimed.

workflow_evidence.reason: Candidate, actual frozen binary, corrected rubric, dataset, source and every manifest artifact hash verify. Final specs have a deterministic hashed manifest; blind record is unchanged and predates reveal; actual DeepSeek generator and independent Sol identities are recorded. However pane_cols/pane_rect are null for both evidence panes, so actual live width and independent half-pane geometry are unproven. Only the two evidence-pane IDs have closure records; unnamed geometry probes have internally inconsistent counts and no identity/closure proof. These missing required records block a workflow pass. Green validator/self-audit claims do not resolve these gaps or the known rendered failures.

animation.reason: Required by the network source. Full-cycle direct frames 0-20 show all seven dots on the second exterior route cell at frame 0, never at the first drawn source-adjacent origin. No sampled frame shows a visible dot at any arrowhead. v1 short routes disappear at frame 15 while long routes persist through 19; v2 DB-bound routes disappear at 19 while Web->Redis persists. Frame 20 is empty, not one-dot-per-line simultaneous arrival. There are 19 missing-dot route-frame samples, no excess dots, no reversed visible movement, and no source-specified rate exception. Sparse/slow interior movement alone cannot pass.

findings.description: Defect: session is legible but its owner is not. At [33,20,7,1] it touches the queries/Web->DB stem at column 40; the actual Web->Redis source leg is at column 42. A reader can assign session to Web->DB even though the expected relation is Web->Redis. This is visible semantic ambiguity, not an unsupported-format evidence gap.

Defect: frame-0 dots on all seven routes start one drawn cell downstream from the actual route origin. v1 origin/dot pairs are (35,15)/(35,16), (35,23)/(35,24), (35,31)/(35,32), (37,31)/(37,32); v2 pairs are (42,19)/(42,20), (40,19)/(40,20), (30,27)/(30,28). This fails animation and invokes the explicit arrow-traceability direction-unproven rule. Coordinates refer to frame 0 in each direct dump.

Defect: no full-cycle sample contains one visible dot at each arrowhead together. Short v1 routes have no dot at frames 15-20 while long routes retain theirs through 19; v2 DB-bound dots vanish at 19 while Web->Redis retains a dot through 19. No route ever visibly reaches its arrowhead, and frame 20 is all empty. Nineteen route-frame dots are missing. Absorption by arrowhead glyphs is not the required visible finished state. Full-cycle contradictory evidence makes this failure, not merely a missing-frame blocker. Regions identify the terminal arrowheads; relevant frame numbers are 15-20 in v1 and 19-20 in v2.

Defect: the v2 crossing at (40,21) is distinguishable with a bridge but avoidable. Keeping the same Web/Redis/DB boxes and tiers, assigning the Web->Redis stem to the left port and Web->DB to the right allows the former to turn left without crossing the latter. This is a geometric counterargument, not a newly rendered replacement. No source group reordering, link merging or tier change is needed. Both attempted orientations retaining a crossing do not prove a topological necessity.

Evidence gap / blocker: both manifests record pane_cols=null and pane_rect=null. Header tokens and direct viewport lines prove the rendered grid, not a separate actual live-pane width or the even-split composition. No independent pane geometry capture is present. The manifest and generation record are non-grid records, so this finding has no fabricated screen region.

Evidence gap / blocker: w7E:pBN and w7E:pBQ are confirmed closed by their manifests, but geometry probe pane IDs and corresponding closure records are absent. generation.json claims three opened/closed panes yet describes two geometry probes plus the two evidence panes; generation.md gives a different interpretation of a probe pair. Cannot certify cleanup of every owned pane or failed probe. No pane is asserted leaked, and no foreign pane was touched by this reviewer.
